svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two (mirror pair). Plate 20 mm, 370 x 250 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 40 mm for the lower roll bush: 110 mm up from the plate's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge, 150 mm from its front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pinch slot 60 mm wide from 140 mm up to the top, centred over the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bore. Bending slot 60 mm wide from 80 mm up to the top, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 90 mm behind the bore. File both slots smooth and parallel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs: 50 x 50 x 3 RHS 694 mm long under the plate at 30 mm and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 340 mm from the front edge, with 80 x 80 x 6 mm foot plates.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top bridge (bolted, not welded): 25 x 25 mm bar 370 mm long with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M16 and M20 threaded holes over the slots; 2 x M10 into the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: plate inner faces 920 mm apart; legs bolted to the base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both bores line up within 0.5 mm (a 30 mm bar through).
